titulo: Past Perfect and Narrative Time Reference
descripcion: At B1 you introduce the past perfect for the first time: it shows one past event happened before another past event. By the time we arrived, the film had already started — without this structure, the order of events becomes unclear.

ejemplos.texto: By the time we arrived, the film had already started.
She had already left when I called.
I realised I had forgotten my keys.

notas: The past perfect (had + participle) marks the event that happened first, earlier than the other past event.
Before and after already show the order, so the past perfect is optional there; with when, it's not.
This structure is new at B1 and needs a lot of practice before it becomes automatic.

contraste.es: El español tiene el pluscuamperfecto con la misma función (había llegado), así que el concepto no es nuevo — la dificultad es acostumbrarse a usarlo activamente en inglés.

errores: Using the past simple for both events, losing the sense of order.
Using the wrong participle after had.
Overusing the past perfect where before/after already make the order clear.

traducciones.fr: Quand je suis arrivé(e), … avait déjà…

traducciones.es: Me di cuenta de que había…
traducciones.de: Mir wurde klar, dass ich… hatte.
traducciones.fr: Je me suis rendu compte que j’avais…
traducciones.it: Mi sono reso/a conto che avevo…
